spans.s: म्रक्ष् (I) vt. 1P (pres. म्रक्षति) 1. To accumulate, to gather; 2. to mb.
म्रक्ष् (II) vt. 10U (pres. म्रक्षयति-ते) 1. To accumulate; 2. to rub, to smear; 3. to combine.
म्रक्षण n. 1. Smearing the body with unguents; 2. heaping up; 3. oil.
म्रद् vt. 1Ā (pres. म्रदते; caus. म्रदयति-ते) To crush, to pound, to trample upon.
म्रदिमन् m. 1. Tenderness, softness; 2. mildness, Sis.ii.49.
